description: Get a connector sign-in: pending, authorizing, finishing, connected (with the connector), declined, failed (with a fixed failure code) or expired. With wait, waits up to 25 s while it isn't done; call again until it is.

sign_in_id.description: The sign-in's id, as helix_foundry_connect returned it.

wait.description: Wait up to 25 s while it is pending, authorizing or finishing, then return it either way; call again until done.

workspace_id.description: Helix workspace identifier. May be empty when the caller has only one workspace (a service key always does).

name: helix_foundry_get_sign_in

extraction.description: The source's set as entity extraction reads it; present exactly when pieces_set_id is.

documents.description: Pieces the set holds as documents; generate_ontology's mode extraction needs at least one.

max_documents.description: The most it holds: the source's newest pieces by arrival, at every sync.

max_month_usd.description: The most that work spends on the source in a UTC month.

month_usd.description: US dollars that work no person started (refreshes, and extracts no one asked for) spent extracting its documents this UTC month, for every ontology that reads it.

paused.description: True while its syncs write no documents: the set holds some, and work no person started can spend no more on it this UTC month (month_usd reached max_month_usd, or the workspace's share for all its API sources, or for all such work, is spent). The graph keeps the pieces it has, and new pieces wait for next month or a load a person starts.

last_received_at.description: When its newest send arrived; absent before any.

pending_pieces.description: Pieces no sync has read yet.

pieces_set_id.description: The source's own document set: its newest pieces as Markdown documents, which generate_ontology reads with event_sources mode extraction (document_set_ids never names it). Absent without a text field, and until a sync has made a document of a piece.

send_url.description: An app without an MCP client can POST the same pieces here, data as a JSON object, with a send token as its bearer and a client_token on every send; absent on a stamp without the HTTP endpoint.

text_field.description: The top-level field holding each piece's text, locked as a string: the body of each piece's document, which entity extraction reads. Absent when the source has none.

token_url.description: The source's page in Foundry, where a person makes a send token (hx_ev_) for a sender that isn't them; no tool returns one.

title: Get a connector sign-in
